label: Text 1
transcript: The class read Sonnet 73 (That time of year thou mayst in me behold). Mr. Yilmaz asked: what does the speaker want from the addressee? The class argued for forty minutes. Maja said: for the love to be more, not less, because the time is shorter. The class agreed.

label: Text 2
transcript:
That time of year thou mayst in me behold,
When yellow leaves, or none, or few, do hang
Upon those boughs which shake against the cold,
Bare ruined choirs, where late the sweet birds sang.
